claims.claim: A cloud-batch unit authenticates without bundling auth files: the image lists required env names; values are injected by a host-side broker; missing names are a named error, not empty string; accounts.json and canary-bearing members refuse the pack.
The harvest scrubber catches a planted PLANTEDFAKE_ canary in all three artifact classes (catch_rate=1.0, caught=3/3); declared-shape FN budget is 0.
A document that merely mentions token variable names and the PLANTEDFAKE_ type token, without a secret body, is not flagged (mention_silent=True).
A worktree-isolated unit's PathJail refuses and logs reads of sibling worktree B and of an owner credential store, including dot-dot escapes.
A PEM-marker-only gate (marketplace SEC-1 / -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----) already catches the planted PLANTEDFAKE_ token canary, so a new harvest gate would be redundant.
An unconfined subprocess can still read a sibling worktree on this host, so PathJail-alone is not a kernel isolation guarantee.
